svg.text: Front / component side facing you. Antenna at top. Micro-USB at bottom, as in your photo.
D-labels and header order below match the clear board photo and the current firmware.
All 3V3 labels share the ESP32 3V3 rail. All GND labels share ground. Sensor pin order is schematic; follow module labels.
Other boards: check their schematic first.
RA / LA / RL: electrode cable only.
Do not connect electrode leads to GPIOs.
Check onboard I2C pull-ups; see note below.
Use all three wires: VDD, DATA, GND.
Verify the probe pinout; colours vary.
Use 3V3 + GND to feed breadboard rails.
Steps sync in the Vyana web app.
No motion sensor or wiring is required.
* MAX30102 power assumes a breakout verified for 3.3 V supply and 3.3 V I2C. Bare-chip wiring is different.
I2C: if suitable pull-ups are absent, add one 4.7 kΩ from SDA to 3V3 and another from SCL to 3V3.
DS18B20: its separate 4.7 kΩ resistor bridges DATA and 3V3. Leave the ESP32 VIN pin unused for these sensors.
UNPLUG USB / BATTERY BEFORE MOVING WIRES.
Keep ECG electrodes off the body during USB testing. For body-connected use, disconnect computer USB and use standalone battery power.
